I mean, I spend hours on these accounts, and it’s like they have this coordinated effort to sabotage my performance and make it look like I don't know what I'm doing.

He spent like an hour showing me how the reports don't prove that anyone is messing with my numbers, but I just... I know what I see. I know they're tracking me. Even when he shows me that paperwork, it doesn't explain how the vendors know exactly when to shift the numbers to make my buys look like a total failure. Well, free of them? No, not really. Not anytime recently, anyway.
